description:
Read a PDF from a URL as text, page by page, with its title, author and page count. Works on text-layer PDFs up to 25 MB and 300 pages; scanned PDFs without a text layer are refused at no charge.

$0.005 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote. The first 3 calls a day through this tool server are free (no wallet needed).

When to use: The link is a PDF (a filing, paper, contract or manual) and you need its text.
Use instead: read_page for an ordinary web page.
Parameters: url: absolute http(s) URL of the PDF. max_pages: read at most this many pages, 1-300, default 50.
Returns: title, author, page_count, pages_read and pages[] of text in order. Scanned PDFs with no text layer are refused at no charge.

max_pages.description: Read at most this many pages (default 50).

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a PDF.

name: pdf_to_text
title: PDF to text
